content.text:
Header links and buttons now share one 44px control size, so **Application data** and **Sign out** match.

The mismatch came from styling `<button>` globally with `min-height` and padding, while `<a class="header-secondary-btn">` only got padding and inherited body line-height. Same pattern showed up on Apply on company site vs Re-render PDF, and it made the short **CV** tab look circular next to Cover letter.

What changed:

- Shared control tokens (`--control-height: 2.75rem` / 44px) in both token files, documented in `design.md`
- Chrome recipes (`header-secondary-btn`, primary, filter, dialog, tabs) now set the same box model on links and buttons
- Status chips use that height; the secondary job-action row is a 4-column grid
- Unstyled `.secondary-btn` / `.btn-ghost` alias the header recipe
- Cache-bust unified to `styles.css?v=91` on panel, company, apply, and admin

Measured at desktop and 375px: Application data / Sign out, job-action links vs buttons, CV / Cover letter, dialog Cancel / primary, and filter vs select are all **44px**. Avatar stays a 32px circle on purpose.

Reload the company workspace once so the new stylesheet isn’t cached.

Grid items stretch, but the inner card does not fill the cell, so there is no leftover space for `margin-top: auto`. ## Where the same pattern exists | Surface | Sibling cards with CTAs | Status | | --- | --- | --- | | Pricing `/pricing` | Free / Credit packs / Full Access | Broken (screenshot) | | Homepage [AccessSection](homepage/components/AccessSection.tsx) | Public preview / Personal workspace | Almost: panels are already `flex-col`, `ul` has `flex: 1`. First card’s button is not in a footer group; make `margin-top: auto` explicit | | MCP capabilities, country visa cards | Copy only, no CTA | Skip | | Product credits packs | Whole tile is the button; grid already stretches | Skip | | Product job/status rows | Already a control grid from the size pass | Skip | ## Fix **Pricing** in [homepage/app/pricing/page.tsx](homepage/app/pricing/page.tsx): - Grid: `items-stretch` - Each `Card`: `flex h-full flex-col` - Wrap each card’s actions in a footer: `mt-auto flex w-full flex-col gap-3 pt-6` - Full Access: stack **Open workspace** and **Explore MCP** in that footer (`flex-col`, not `flex-wrap`) so the pair pins as one block - Pass `w-full` into `AuthCta` / `Button` so widths match inside the card (inline-flex today sizes to the label) **Access section** in [homepage/app/globals.css](homepage/app/globals.css) (and wrap the first panel button in [AccessSection.tsx](homepage/components/AccessSection.tsx) with `access-panel-actions`): - `.access-panel-actions { margin-top: auto; align-self: stretch; width: 100%; }` - Buttons inside: `width: 100%` so both columns share a footer edge on the 2-col grid (`min-width: 720px`) Do not make every `.card` globally flex — workflow / single cards would pick up an unused column layout. ## Verify - Pricing at desktop (`md+`): three orange CTAs on one baseline; Full Access secondary under its primary, still in the pinned footer - Pricing stacked (narrow): footers stay at the bottom of each card; no horizontal-align requirement - Homepage Access: Search the catalog vs Open the workspace on one line - `cd homepage && npm run build:flask` so Flask static export in `relocation_jobs/static/homepage/` matches No panel CSS / cache-bust unless Access-only CSS is enough.
